title: copilot doctor --json
description: Health verdict Control Tower renders in the tray. Mirrors `cc memory check`. Exit 0 clean / 1 any fail / 2 env error. `status` is computed CLI-side; the app only renders it.

host.description: Host identifier the verdict was computed for.

status.$comment: cli-contract.md says status is computed CLI-side but does not enumerate the value set. Encoded as healthy|degraded|failed, aligned to the 0/1/2 exit-code intent (env errors surface via exit 2). Owner should confirm the exact string set.

offline.description: True when the verdict was produced without network reachability.

items.$comment: The contract lists an explicit trailing ellipsis on the checker object, so it is intentionally open/extensible; additionalProperties is left true. Known security-relevant fields are required.

repair.description: Repair action available for this checker, or null when none.
repair.$comment: Prose names the field `repair` without a type. Encoded as a nullable repair-action identifier; it may instead be a boolean 'repair available' flag. Owner to confirm.

destructive.description: Whether the associated repair is destructive. Security-relevant: a missing value is treated as destructive (fail-closed), so the CLI must always emit it.

auth.$comment: cli-contract.md shows `auth:[...]` with an unspecified element shape; encoded as an open array of objects until the CLI freezes the item schema.

allOf.$comment: Encodes the 'a false Healthy is impossible' invariant to the degree it is structurally encodable: a healthy verdict may not be offline and may not contain any checker whose severity is fail.
